title.en: An Act Establishing A National High School in Barangay Lipit, Municipality of Cabugao, Province of Ilocos Sur, To Be Known As Lipit National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing A National High School in Barangay Lipit, Municipality of Cabugao, Province of Ilocos Sur, To Be Known As Lipit National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia tại Barangay Lipit, Thị trấn Cabugao, Tỉnh Ilocos Sur được biết đến với tên gọi Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia Lipit
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Lipit, เทศบาล Cabugao, จังหวัด Ilocos Sur ให้เป็นที่รู้จักในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ Lipit
title.id: Undang-Undang mendirikan Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional di Barangay Lipit, Kotamadya Cabugao, Provinsi Ilocos Sur dikenal sebagai Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional Lipit
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan di Barangay Lipit, Perbandaran Cabugao, Wilayah Ilocos Sur dikenali sebagai Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan Lipit

text.en: There shall be established a national high school in Barangay Lipit, Municipality of Cabugao, Province of Ilocos Sur, to be known as Lipit National High School.
The Secretary of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue the rules and regulations to implement this Act.
The amount necessary for the implementation of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
